question: Recommend asset classes to invest when the USD currency is appreciated, and when it is depreciated
query: SELECT   "stock_index",   "close_price" FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE   "close_price" > (     SELECT       PERCENTILE_CONT(close_price)     FROM finance_economics_dataset     ORDER BY       "close_price" DESC     LIMIT 50   ) ORDER BY   "close_price" DESC LIMIT 50;
